label: Regeneration by positive feedback
subgoals: Model the latch as gm charging C with positive feedback
Write the exponential growth with tau equal to C over gm
Compute the regeneration time as tau times the log of the gain needed

label: Metastability
subgoals: Invert the regeneration formula for the smallest resolvable input
Relate the metastability probability to e to the minus T over tau
Budget time constants per decision against the error rate

label: Offset and the preamplifier
subgoals: Refer the latch offset to the input by dividing by preamp gain
Weigh preamp gain against power, delay and calibration
